set.body: Normative PRD: docs/plans/response-representation-archive-architecture.md, revised 2026-07-27. Converge on a neutral response kernel, typed representation planning, archive resources, checked dataset opening, typed interop, and explicit runtime assembly. The decoded response is a non-generic row-major Double ResponseBlock that owns primitive storage directly; no response tensor framework is introduced. FmriDataset and model/fit plans remain pure, while ResponseSource[F], OpenedDataset[F], and runtime interpreters own effects. Completion requires an exact committed baseline and frozen numerical regression corpus; one nontrivial decoder proven unchanged through memory, LNA-HDF5, and Zarr under DecodeConsistency; unknown-representation inspection; transactional publication; axis-keyed locality receipts; concrete openResponse/openDataset runtime paths; executable import/build guards; factual versioned LNA adaptation; JVM and Scala.js laws; warning-clean compileAll/testAll; and removal of all pre-release forwarding aliases and historical response/archive names.
